model.domain: Finite unit-client game and finite nonempty common legal labeled catalog; every complete ordered-history pure SPE; weak ties, label aliases, repeated actions and empty coverage are retained.
model.actual_prefix: For the fixed complete pure SPE and its actual actions A1,...,A6, P_y=sum_{j=1}^4 1[y in cov(A_j)].
model.X: Choose X once from argmax_{Q in the whole legal catalog} f_P(Q), where f_P(Q)=sum_{y in cov(Q)} 1/(P_y+1). Use that same X in every customer membership bit, query and forced branch.
model.X_scope: Maximality is relative to the actual first-four prefix P. It is not asserted at the root zero background, at a modified prefix or at arbitrary other histories. Weak ties are allowed; X need not be unique or maximize bare coverage.
model.C: Choose C as one whole-catalog maximum bare-coverage legal label, K=|cov(C)|. C need not maximize f_P; X and C may agree or differ.
model.O_and_normalization: O is the union of six legal labels attaining OPT6. Normalize all masses, utilities, F_X and K by OPT6 only for OPT6>0; handle OPT6=0 directly.
model.new_local_T: The arbitrary-legal-T quantifier in the new local sources specializes to the globally selected X and does not cancel the inherited X maximality of the 3056 old rows.
model.boundary: A necessary LP feasible point is not a complete SPE realization; no numerical or exact LP claim has been produced because released preflight stopped.

local_release_publication_state: Main-created local release; not claimed pushed.
